title: Photocatalytic water splitting reference family
reaction: 2 H2O + hν -> 2 H2 + O2 (overall) | 2 H2O + hν -> 2 H2 + O2 via half-reactions
objective: Optional literature-backed family for solar-driven photocatalytic water splitting using powder photocatalysts. Candidates compare a TiO2 (anatase) anchor with the metal-free graphitic carbon nitride (g-C3N4) polymer photocatalyst and a Pt/TiO2 cocatalyst route, so the screening can reward the canonical oxide baseline, a non-PGM polymer variant, or a precious-metal cocatalyst boost.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported solar-to-hydrogen activity.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward photocatalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and more reproducible photocatalyst preparation routes.

citations.label: Nature 1972
citations.note: Fujishima and Honda: electrochemical photolysis of water at a semiconductor (TiO2) electrode, the founding observation for semiconductor photocatalysis.

citations.label: Nature Materials 2008
citations.note: Wang, Maeda et al.: a metal-free polymeric photocatalyst (g-C3N4) for hydrogen production from water under visible light, foundational metal-free photocatalyst paper.

citations.label: Chem. Soc. Rev. 2009
citations.note: Kudo and Miseki: foundational review of heterogeneous photocatalyst materials for water splitting, organising oxide, oxynitride, and sulfide families.

citations.label: Chem. Rev. 2010
citations.note: Chen, Shen et al.: comprehensive review of semiconductor-based photocatalytic hydrogen generation, covering material classes, cocatalyst strategies, and kinetic principles.

citations.label: Chem. Rev. 2010
citations.note: Walter, Warren et al.: foundational review of solar water splitting cells, comparing photoelectrochemical, photocatalytic, and photovoltaic-electrolysis architectures.

citations.label: Nature Materials 2013
citations.note: Scanlon, Dunnill et al.: band alignment of rutile and anatase TiO2, explaining the anatase-vs-rutile activity gap that underpins TiO2 photocatalyst selection.

citations.label: Chem. Soc. Rev. 2014
citations.note: Wang, Zhang et al.: review of semiconductor heterojunction photocatalysts covering design, construction, and photocatalytic performance, bridging single-phase and composite designs.

citations.label: Nature Catalysis 2019
citations.note: Hisatomi and Domen: reaction systems for solar hydrogen production via water splitting with particulate semiconductor photocatalysts, framing scale-up paths and operating constraints.

route_templates.name: TiO2 (anatase) photocatalyst route
route_templates.route_note: Mature anatase TiO2 powder route, broadly used as the canonical oxide photocatalyst baseline.

route_templates.name: g-C3N4 polymer route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Bulk graphitic carbon nitride photocatalyst preparation
route_templates.route_note: Metal-free polymer photocatalyst route, attractive when avoiding metal-based active phases is the program goal.

route_templates.name: Pt / TiO2 cocatalyst route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: TiO2 photocatalyst with Pt cocatalyst loading
synthesis: Reduction or photo-reduction to metallic Pt
quality_gates: Hydrogen-evolution activity hold under UV / visible light
route_templates.route_note: Pt cocatalyst on TiO2 route, established way to boost H2 evolution rate over the bare-oxide baseline at the cost of precious-metal exposure.

candidates.title: TiO2 (anatase) baseline
candidates.summary: Bulk anatase TiO2 photocatalyst used as the canonical oxide baseline for solar water splitting screening.
decision_notes: Most transferable oxide photocatalyst basis and the clearest comparison anchor across the literature.
UV-only activity limits solar-to-hydrogen performance versus visible-light variants.

pricing.note: Anatase TiO2 powder cost held on an engineering proxy comparable to commercial photocatalyst-grade titania.

candidates.title: g-C3N4 metal-free photocatalyst
candidates.summary: Graphitic carbon nitride polymer photocatalyst for visible-light hydrogen evolution, offering a fully metal-free option.
decision_notes: Use when avoiding metals altogether is the program goal and visible-light operation is required.
Pyrolysis precursor choice and exfoliation discipline drive activity reproducibility.

pricing.note: g-C3N4 powder held on a derived screening proxy reflecting nitrogen-precursor and pyrolysis processing overhead.

candidates.title: Pt / TiO2 cocatalyst
candidates.summary: TiO2 anatase loaded with a Pt cocatalyst to boost H2 evolution rate over the bare-oxide baseline.
decision_notes: Use when boosting H2 evolution rate is worth Pt exposure and a TiO2 base is acceptable.
Activity gains plateau at low Pt loading; further Pt addition adds cost without proportional activity.

pricing.note: Live Pt feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup for cocatalyst loading screening.
Anatase TiO2 base powder cost held on an engineering proxy comparable to the bare TiO2 baseline.
